name: @imprint/ui
description: Imprint design system — the component library the app builds screens from.
//: This manifest sits inside the app's own source tree, so those fields would
hijack directory resolution: `import { Button } from '@/ui'` would resolve
to ./dist/index.mjs — the last *built* snapshot — instead of ./index.ts.
The app would then silently run stale components until someone remembered
to re-run `npm run build:ui`, which is exactly the bug this comment exists
Nothing needs those fields. `npm run build:ui` names ./index.ts as its
entry directly, and design-sync is passed --entry ./src/ui/dist/index.mjs
on the command line. The file is kept only so the package has a name and
version for the design-sync converter to report.
